loop_b.location: Selected Loop B manifest.configuration; per-model manifest.offline_evaluation
loop_b.meaning: READY/COMPLETED describes route/pipeline completion; not independent Gameplan promotion or sizing qualification. Scheduled require_all_routes rejects unresolved required route/model errors.

independent_directional.gate: Saved new v2: Brier <= baseline+0.005; logloss <= baseline+0.01; ECE <=0.15; >=10 assessment clusters; retained calibration and assessment variation. Exact missing fitted symbol/route becomes RESEARCH_NO_TARGET_HISTORY.
independent_directional.important: Native publication can COMPLETE with RESEARCH_NOT_PROMOTED. Final audit coverage notes do not replace explicit defect diagnosis of fresh failures.
independent_directional.retention: If deployment=RETAINED_VERIFIED_CHAMPION, inspect deployment.challenger_status and challenger_report_output as well as the published report. Retention is same-action-date compatible latest champion, never assessment ranking.

learned_sizing.meaning: MODELS_FIT/FITTED is distinct from READY qualification. Current pooled scope needs >=1 exact fitted cluster, >=20 pooled symbol/route clusters and passing horizon assessment >=10 clusters.
learned_sizing.gate: Brier/logloss/return MSE strictly beat respective baselines; adverse MSE <= baseline; ECE <=0.15; probability range >1e-8. This differs from directional-v2 tolerances.

diagnosis_order: Capture exact fresh FIT_WARNING/FIT_ERROR group/phase, run identity, deadline and saved report/cohort/model hashes; do not equate target-quality exclusions with an assessment failure.
Reproduce gate arithmetic and verify probability-target, source and feature contract, class/support counts and purged chronological partition boundaries.
Check finite features, duplicate targets, causal clocks, native five-minute endpoints, raw-return labels, archive exclusions and real fitting/convergence diagnostics.
Verify fixed development candidate/grid/tie selection, calibration refit eligibility and assessment_used_for_selection=false; weekly fixed shrinkage/prior consistency.
After native COMPLETE, run root's immutable audit once to reproduce source cohorts and fitted assessment scores; do not retrain or rank alternatives on assessment.

For each failed group, distinguish evidence/implementation defect with feasible tested repair from faithfully reproduced quality/evidence shortfall. No unchanged retry, threshold relaxation or fabricated rows.

Any concrete repair is dispatched separately under root ownership, native eligible failed-stage recovery and original deadline. Never edit immutable publications or rerun a fully completed source session.
